verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Linear extension surface that would let a designer build custom views or dashboard widgets rendered natively inside the product. Shareable filtered views (linear-docs-13) are a related built-in feature, not custom-built native views or widgets. The 'Build custom dashboards and analytics' line (linear-docs-84) is an integration-directory listing, which points to an external tool rather than Linear's own capability. Because the axis applies to a work-management product, the absence of evidence means 'none'.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
